name: sentinel
description: A progress panel and band for the goal, every task and every subagent, and a highlighter pen for Claude's replies.

highlight.title: Highlighter
highlight.description: Who marks what matters in a reply. reader: a second, small model reads each reply after the turn and marks it. claude: the replying model marks its own text as it writes (no extra call; adds a short section to the system prompt). both: the two together. bold: every bold phrase. off: the highlighter does nothing by itself; only your own /highlight marks.

color.title: Pen color
color.description: The color of the highlighter pen.

reader.title: Second reader
reader.description: What the second reader is. fast: the model named below, which sees the reply, what you asked and a digest of the turn's tool calls. session: a fork of the session on its own model, which sees the whole conversation and costs a cached re-read of it.

readerModel.title: Second reader model
readerModel.description: The model the fast second reader uses: an alias (haiku) or a full model id.

band.title: Progress band
band.description: The band above the prompt: the task count and progress bar, the task in progress and its time, open problems and the main thread's context, with each subagent on the line under it.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: When the side panel opens. auto: by itself, when a subagent starts. manual: only when you type /progress.

breakdown.title: Break work into tasks
breakdown.description: on: a short section of the system prompt asks Claude, and the end of each subagent's task asks the subagent, to write a task list before work of three or more steps and keep it as it goes, so the panel and the band show the work even when you did not ask for a list. off: Claude keeps a list only when it decides to.

tasks.title: Task list tool
tasks.description: Where the session's model has no task list tool of Claude Code's own, the mod gives it one, so the panel and the band have tasks to show. auto: offer it then. off: never (the task list then shows only what Claude Code's own tools keep).
